verdicts.reason: Both rebuild the design as a sensible left-to-right leaderboard: striped strip, then the box, the headline and the CTA. In both, the box sticks out over the stripe/lime boundary and the subcopy is tiny at 90px tall. A's subcopy breaks awkwardly ('every / size still in stock'). B fixes that line break, but its pink badge sinks almost to the bottom edge, its bigger box crowds the headline, and its CTA is jammed close to the right edge, so A is slightly better balanced.
